WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 5 AS first_week, 8 AS last_week
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(*) AS n_rows
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
    GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT * FROM weekly ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_week

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS mine FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       ROUND(m.mine,2) AS mine, ROUND(c.ctl,2) AS ctl, ROUND(m.mine - c.ctl,2) AS diff
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.business_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN ctl c ON c.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE (d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8)
ORDER BY d.calendar_date

SELECT

  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_keys,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_ids,

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at,
  count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no) AS n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sale_date) AS dates, count(DISTINCT net_amount) AS amts, count(DISTINCT product_key) AS prods, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT n, dates, amts, prods, loads, count(*) AS keys, min(receipt_id) AS min_r, max(receipt_id) AS max_r FROM dups GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT d2.fiscal_year, d2.fiscal_week, f.sale_date, count(*) AS dup_rows, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_in_dup_rows
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=f.sale_date
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
